title: Surreal Mind Throne
description: A surreal scene inside a gothic greenhouse features a young boy with a cracked blue head leaking colorful fluids, chained by red threads to a skeletal wolf king wearing a golden crown and red cape. A green octopus-like creature with sharp teeth drips slime near floating tacos and donuts, surrounded by books, potion bottles, eyeballs, and purple flowers under a starry night window.
prompt: Surreal psychedelic scene set inside a gothic greenhouse at night. A boy with a cracked open head revealing a starry blue brain stands in profile as colorful liquids drip down his face. He is connected by red threads to a skeletal wolf creature wearing a golden crown and red royal cape, holding a book. A green toothy octopus monster drips slime beside floating tacos, donuts, and eyeballs. Shelves of colorful potions, open books, purple flowers, and melting elements fill the frame in a dark vibrant palette.
